entry.title: I Got Isekai’d Into Miraculous—Now They Want Me to Break the Love-Square?! Tch. I’m a Robin. I’ll Fix It My Way.
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 254,248Chapters: 96/99Kudos: 725

Summary: Five years Damian waited for the last Miraculous Ladybug manga, and the ending sucks. Enraged, he boasted he could write a better story. A mischievous, fifth-dimensional imp quickly appears and gives him a chance to prove his claim. To prevent a disappointing ending, he must change the plot as he sees fit. What would a genius detective, Robin, do in the MLB Universe, to cause Chaos of course! ​He wakes up in a world where he is dead, but Alfred is his living ally. With just seven days until the plot kicks off, Damian dedicates himself to healing the fractured Batfamily, slowly putting the pieces back together. But he can multitask. To prevent the Love Square, he decides to aggressively befriend Marinette Dupain-Cheng the only way a Wayne knows how: by replacing her friends with competent ones and burying her under a mountain of gifts. Who knew purchasing platonic affection required so much cashmere? (I am currently writing the final arc. )

Summary: A year after the defeat of Hawkmoth, Marinette is out of school, Guardian of the Miraculous, and unable to move on.When the Order challenges her titles, Marinette won’t give up without a fight. She arrives at the Order, determined to stay a Guardian and help the Order reclaim their place in the world—all while carrying the weight of her new power and responsibilities. Fortunately, Marinette has luck on her side.Damian Wayne is lost.He is nineteen, out of school, and feels out of place in his life. With no clear path forward, Damian follows his mother back to the League of Assassins to bury his past once and for all. Of course, nothing ever goes to plan.Upon learning that an ancient, magical organization has returned and is demanding his presence as the Demon Head, Damian makes the decision to accept his place in the League—making an enemy of his mother.Convinced they can reform their factions with each other’s help, Marinette and Damian must get through new enemies, old oaths, and their own building feelings—all while avoiding their fast-approaching deadline to be Soul Bound.Alone, it would be too much for anyone to handle. Together, they’ll face it all.

entry.title: Lie Lie Lie
entry.summary:
Author: krono2011

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 339,032Chapters: 108/108Kudos: 1,676

Summary: Marinette Dupain-Cheng's life fell apart. Adrien's discovery that his father was Hawk Moth and that his girlfriend had lied destroyed their relationship. Her mother let her leave the city after Chrysalis's death, releasing her from despair. She didn't go to Shanghai. Uncle Wang needed help with his new restaurant. Goodbye, City of Love, hello Gotham, Capital of Crime. Damian Wayne does not get “dumped.” However, with the high-profile Wayne Gala looming and his brothers actively plotting to mock his solo status, he requires an immediate tactical maneuver: a pretend girlfriend. His designated target? Maps Mizoguchi. Approaching a familiar silhouette with raven hair beneath a tree, he coldly issues a command for a romantic alliance. However, when the girl turns around, he realizes it isn't Maps. Instead, it's a thoroughly bewildered French transfer student clutching a macaron. A lesser man would apologize for the mistake. Damian Wayne? He simply doubles down. She has the right hair color, and she is a variable he can control. “You,” he decides, utterly refusing to admit defeat. “You are an acceptable substitute. Don’t be late.”

Summary: Damian was a boy when Ra’s had been killed. He remembered when the ambush was over and they were safe in a safe house his mother bent down and looked him in the eyes. “Damian, this will be your true test for whether or not you will be ready to take the title of the Demon’s Head.” It had taken Damian two months to put an end to Deathstroke and his traitorous men. The portrait of his sword, buried deep inside Wilson’s heart, hung in Nanda Parbat. Unworthy blood had stained the ground of his ancestors and it was his task to cleanse it. To restore honor and balance back to the Order of Shadows and to the world itself. Now, years later his informant has told him the Miraculous have been activated. She was not trained, she couldn’t even fall correctly, but she was smart, agile, a born tactician. If nothing else, Damian knew that he needed to follow her. She would be an invaluable asset to him and the League itself.
